Which Episode was the best from Season Two?

  • Rocketship X-M
  • The Sidehackers
  • Jungle Goddess
  • Catalina Caper
  • Rocket Attack U.S.A.
  • Ring of Terror
  • Wild Rebels
  • Lost Continent
  • The Hellcats
  • King Dinosaur
  • First Spaceship on Venus
  • Godzilla vs. Megalon
  • Godzilla vs. the Sea Monster

This season is my sentimental favorite because it is the one that I watched over and over again on VHS when I was a kid. As a result, it is very hard to pick a favorite.

  1. Sidehackers is the crew's first Ross Hagan film and they give it a beautiful send up. They tear into the ridiculous padding of the film with musical interludes and montages, the terrible dialogue (ex. "Chili peppers burn my gut.", "Ever see Big Jake break a man's spine?", "That was number nine!"), and characters that were so unlikable that you were glad when everyone died.

  2. Catalina Caper is probably on of my top 10 MST3K episodes of all time. With a ton of great jokes and a beautiful solo piece from Tom Servo, you can tell that the Joel and the Bots really had fun with this one. The film itself is just a perfect crystallization of 60's teen exploitation. Tons of "rock & roll", tons of dancing, tons of bikinis, and tons gags that were hackneyed even by that era's standards.

  3. My favorite has to be Wild Rebels. With very few exceptions, almost nothing tops this episode for me. Great jokes, great bridge interludes, terrible terrible movie. We also get to find out that what Gypsy does on the ship and why she speaks so slowly. I have been singing the crew's "Wild Rebel" cereal song for decades.

Definitely one of my favorite seasons.

  1. Cave Dwellers just... just couldn't have been worse. Blatant Conan rip offs, terrible stilted acting, awful foley work, out of nowhere hang glider, obvious four-wheeler tracks in the background... there had to be some nepotism or serious favors involved in the making of this film. Thankfully though, this pile of manure was perfect fertilizer for a hilarious episode to bloom.

  2. Gamera is great simply for the bridge interlude where we get to see a young Mike Nelson playing a wife beater wearing Gamera that explains how he cynically uses kids for positive PR.

  3. My favorite has to be Santa Claus Conquers The Martians. To my knowledge this is MST3K's first holiday episode and it is a damn good one. Great jokes, great interludes, fun invention exchange, tons of obscure references by the crew, and a well intentioned movie that is beyond bad. It all comes together into a fantastic episode.
